say:1:1621138001:1.source_cn: 几名接头人正站在原地，齐齐望向你。

say:4:1621138005:1.text: Well now... so you are one of Anzel's. Heard he's desperate for manpower. Didn't think he'd scrape together someone who's actually alive.
say:4:1621138005:1.source_cn: 哎哟……果然是安泽的人？听说他最近缺人，没想到还真给他...
say:4:1621138005:1.male: Well now... so you are one of Anzel's. Heard he's desperate for manpower. Didn't think he'd scrape together someone who's actually alive.
say:4:1621138005:1.female: Well now... so you are one of Anzel's. Heard he's desperate for manpower. Didn't think he'd scrape together someone who's actually alive.

say:5:1621138006:1.text: Still, Anzel should really teach his recruit some punctuality. We've been out here in the cold waiting for you... heeheehee.
say:5:1621138006:1.source_cn: 不过啊，你的时间观念可不怎么地，让我们在风里等这么久…...

say:6:1621138007:1.text: Another minute and the boss would've blown up!
say:6:1621138007:1.source_cn: 是啊，再等一会，头儿可要生气了！
say:6:1621138007:1.male: Another minute and the boss would've blown up!
say:6:1621138007:1.female: Another minute and the boss would've blown up!

say:7:1621138008:1.text: This is for Anzel. Bring it to him. Sign here.
say:7:1621138008:1.source_cn: 这是给安泽的东西，你拿给他，并且在这张货单上签字。

say:9:1621138009:1.male: Anzel should've given you a package. Hand it over.

say:11:1621138010:1.text: If I said apples, would you believe me?

say:11:1621138010:1.male: If I said apples, would you believe me?
say:11:1621138010:1.female: If I said apples, would you believe me?

say:12:1621138011:0.text: Anzel went through hell to get these. They'll be juiced for our client!
say:12:1621138011:0.source_cn: 这些苹果是安泽费尽心思弄来的，最后要被制作成苹果汁，供...
say:12:1621138011:0.male: Anzel went through hell to get these. They'll be juiced for our client!
say:12:1621138011:0.female: Anzel went through hell to get these. They'll be juiced for our client!

say:13:1621138012:1.text: We're the ones doing the heavy lifting. For the client, it's just a snap of the fingers!
say:13:1621138012:1.source_cn: 大费周折的是我们，那位大人只是一句话的事！
say:13:1621138012:1.male: We're the ones doing the heavy lifting. For the client, it's just a snap of the fingers!
say:13:1621138012:1.female: We're the ones doing the heavy lifting. For the client, it's just a snap of the fingers!

say:14:1621138013:1.text: And don't think you're done after delivery. Rumor is, they're gonna squeeze out every drop of mana from those used artifacts. That's the real nightmare!
say:14:1621138013:1.source_cn: 别以为你运出来就完事了，我听说啊，接下来还要把这些二手...

say:14:1621138013:1.female: And don't think you're done after delivery. Rumor is, they're gonna squeeze out every drop of mana from those used artifacts. That's the real nightmare!

say:15:1621138014:0.text: But that's someone else's problem now!
say:15:1621138014:0.source_cn: 不过那都是别人的活了，跟我们没关系了！
say:15:1621138014:0.male: But that's someone else's problem now!
say:15:1621138014:0.female: But that's someone else's problem now!

choice:10:1:2.text: All this effort for apple juice?
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 大费周折，就为了运这些东西？
choice:10:1:2.male: All this effort for apple juice?
choice:10:1:2.female: All this effort for apple juice?

say:16:1621138015:0.text: Why all the questions? Wherever our client is, that's where this goes!
say:16:1621138015:0.source_cn: 问那么多干嘛……那位大人在哪，这些东西就会运到哪！
say:16:1621138015:0.male: Why all the questions? Wherever our client is, that's where this goes!
say:16:1621138015:0.female: Why all the questions? Wherever our client is, that's where this goes!

say:17:1621138016:1.text: Heeheehee... you two make a fine pair. One can't stop asking, the other can't stop blabbing.
say:17:1621138016:1.source_cn: 桀桀桀……你们两个真是，一个敢问，一个敢答。
say:17:1621138016:1.male: Heeheehee... you two make a fine pair. One can't stop asking, the other can't stop blabbing.
say:17:1621138016:1.female: Heeheehee... you two make a fine pair. One can't stop asking, the other can't stop blabbing.

say:18:1621138017:1.text: Boss! Are rumors off-limits now? I don't even know if they're true!
say:18:1621138017:1.source_cn: 头儿！传闻都不能说吗？俺自己都不知道传闻是不是真的！

say:23:1621138004:0.text: What's wrong with you? Get lost!
say:23:1621138004:0.source_cn: 哪来的神经病，走开走开！
